The user wants to restore the cursor position, open files, and sidebar visibility when reopening a project.
I have a plan with 3 phases:
1. Cursor position (T1) - Failed. `save workspace session` only persists tab paths and launch args. `Cursor Pos` has no serialization logic.
2. Open files (T2) - Failed/Incomplete. `save workspace session` persists tab paths. `clear tabs`, `open tabs mru` seen.
3. Sidebar visibility (T3) - Failed/Incomplete. `main layout hpp` seen.

Current state:
